program:
app "Score Keeper" ball plum
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs ". Run rate" round(runs * 6 / legal) faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
row gap 1
  each ball today sort at desc top 6
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(it.out, bad, if(it.runs >= 4, good, soft))
      if it.out
        label 50, 50, "W" bold
      else
        label 50, 50, it.runs bold
describe:
Score Keeper, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: overs: number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries today where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball today plus how many ball entries today where wide is yes.
- wkts is how many ball entries today where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", wkts.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down plus legal leaves over when divided by 6 divided by 10, "of", overs, ". Run rate", runs times 6 divided by legal rounded.
- for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries today, with undo.
- for each ball today sorted by at, highest first, first 6:
  - a drawing made of circles, labels.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Eating out" food ocean
table meal_out what text, amount money
let spent = sum(meal_out.amount month)
setting budget money = 12000 "Monthly budget"
screen main "Spend" wallet
  "Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
  if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
  goal spent, budget, "spent"
  form meal_out
screen charts "Charts" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(meal_out.amount on it)
  list meal_out month by day
describe:
Eating out, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- meal out: what: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 12000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of meal out this month.
Shows:
- a screen "Spend":
  - text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
  - text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
  - spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
  - a form to add a meal out.
- a screen "Charts":
  - a bar chart of the total amount of meal out on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
  - a list of meal out this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Workout week" dumbbell mint
table move name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning
table move_done move ref move
let n = count(move)
count(move_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each move
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      it.part faint
    toggle it.move_done
form move
stat max(move, streak(it.move_done)), "best streak"
remind "Time to tick off workouts" at 22:00
describe:
Workout week, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- move: name: text; part: one of Morning, Afternoon, Evening, starts at Morning. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- move done: move: a move. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many move entries.
Shows:
- text: how many move done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
- for each move:
  - a group; a tap opens the move for editing; a swipe removes the move, with undo:
    - text: its name.
    - text: its part.
    - a tick box for its move done.
- a form to add a move.
- a big number: the highest of the current day streak of its move done entries over the move, labelled "best streak".
Reminder "Time to tick off workouts" at 22:00 every day.
